text:
maya: quick postmortem follow-up for GPU capacity/autoscale. We split into three action items: scheduler tuning, quota backstop, and headroom playbook. Keep updates one-line here and link detailed notes on the board.

jon: Ill own scheduler tuning (A-1). Plan: 48h trace replay, small knob sweep, then PR with safe defaults. Target PR: 2025-06-09. Will include a tiny smoke test.

sam (oncall): include an oncall validation checklist in the PR. I can run a simulated surge Sun night.

dina: Ill own quota backstop (A-2). Proposal: soft per-team burst queues with a 10m grace, then route overflow to reserved pool. CSV and enforcement plan by 2025-05-31.

maya: Ill create the headroom playbook (A-3): 1-page checklist, escalation contacts, automated alert at 9% headroom. Draft by 2025-05-29.

jon: sample knobs Im testing in staging:

```
scheduler:
  preemption.deadline_ms: 50000
  backfill.window_sec: 30
  ticket_priority_threshold: 0.7
```

sam (oncall): nice. also add KV cache persistence check and model-fallback verification (quantized -> smaller -> rate-limit).

dina: posted quota mapping to board: https://redwood.internal/boards/gpu-capacity/cards/207. tagging @product-infra for review by 2025-05-30.

ops-bot: created recurring event "GPU capacity remediation sync" weekly Wed 10:00 PT for 6 weeks. Invites sent to maya, jon, dina, sam (oncall). Event link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/13007

maya: owners recap: A-1 jon 2025-06-09; A-2 dina 2025-05-31; A-3 maya 2025-05-29. please post short status updates to the board and tag this thread if blocked. :thumbsup:

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-26) jon: uploaded trace replay and opened PR #1328 with perf charts.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-27) dina: quota CSV posted; waiting on product-infra feedback.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-29) maya: headroom playbook draft published; alert wired to staging.

(ops-bot 2025-06-04) reminder: weekly remediation sync in 48 hours.
